verdict.rationale: Whether an online immigration filing can be started without an account is a fair question for this kind of service, so the axis applies. The evidence confirms the application must be made online (supp-2) and can use the ID Check app (docs-21), but no published page documents starting the core flow without an account, or entering via a reference or file number. The visa-finder tool (docs-1) is an adjacent eligibility checker, not the core filing flow, so it earns no credit.
